description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableResources class, focusing on immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation of resource path uniqueness.

classes.name: ImmutableResourcesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableResources to verify immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and resource path validation.

methods.description: Tests that ImmutableResources instances are immutable.
